en: Black‑and‑white view of a small European town square paved with cobblestones, surrounded by 2‑ to 3‑storey plastered houses with steep tiled roofs. On the left are shopfronts with German signage; in the middle stands a building with the sign "Hermann Hanse" and a tall factory chimney rising behind it. To the right, more houses line a narrow street leading toward a larger building with a clock tower and cross. A lone person stands near a low wall and gate in the center distance.
